SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Thanks to you, the house is this clean every day —

SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Graças a você, a casa tá impecável.

SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 哎呀...我只是做了該做的事而已

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah… aku cuma ngelakuin apa yang memang seharusnya aku lakuin, kok.
